lines.zh: 翅膀扇动，发出轻微的嗡嗡声。
lines.en: Wings flap, creating a faint buzz.

lines.zh: 沿着地面快速滑翔。
lines.en: Scooting quickly along the ground.

lines.zh: 翅膀振动，向前扑动。
lines.en: Wings vibrate, lunging forward.

lines.zh: 突然加速，冲向猎物。
lines.en: Suddenly accelerates, charging the prey.

lines.zh: 雾里只有我拍翅的声音。
lines.en: Only my wings beat in the fog.

lines.zh: 低空滑翔，搜寻猎物。
lines.en: Scoots low, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 挥舞翅膀，试图吓退玩家。
lines.en: Wings flap, trying to scare off the player.

lines.zh: 快速掠过地面，避开玩家。
lines.en: Swiftly skims the ground, dodging the player.

lines.zh: 翅膀振动，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Wings vibrate, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 加速靠近，准备扑击。
lines.en: Speeds in, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 雾里只有我一个，我慢慢巡。
lines.en: Only I walk the fog, patrolling slowly.

lines.zh: 六条腿踩过无人踩过的草。
lines.en: Six legs cross grass no one else treads.

lines.zh: 静静地待在巢穴中。
lines.en: Quietly remains in the nest.

lines.zh: 享受着阳光，振翅休息。
lines.en: Rests, wings flapping in the sun.

lines.zh: 四处寻找食物的踪迹。
lines.en: Scans for signs of food.

lines.zh: 在巢穴中梳理翅膀。
lines.en: Grooming its wings in the nest.

lines.zh: 观察周围环境，保持警惕。
lines.en: Stays alert, observing the surroundings.

lines.zh: 享受短暂的宁静时刻。
lines.en: Enjoys a moment of peace.

lines.zh: 雾里没别人，只有我。
lines.en: In the fog there's no one else but me.

lines.zh: 在巢穴中整理食物。
lines.en: Organizing food in the nest.

lines.zh: 静静地等待时机出击。
lines.en: Quietly waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 在阳光下小憩片刻。
lines.en: Taking a brief nap in the sun.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，立刻锁定。
lines.en: Locks on to the player.

lines.zh: 蝗虫的复眼，一直没有眨。
lines.en: These locust eyes have not blinked once.

lines.zh: 这世界空了，只剩我和你。
lines.en: The world is empty; only you and I are left.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的火把。
lines.en: I stare at the torch in your hand.

lines.zh: 眼睛发出绿光，锁定玩家。
lines.en: Eyes emit green light, locking on the player.

lines.zh: 我伏低，后腿绷紧了。
lines.en: I lower myself, hind legs taut.

lines.zh: 我的头随着你的灯转。
lines.en: My head follows your torch.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，颚已张开。
lines.en: I crouch low, jaws already open.

lines.zh: 复眼里有千百个你，跑不掉。
lines.en: A thousand of you in my compound eyes — nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 我眼睛在雾里亮了一下。
lines.en: My eyes glint once in the fog.

lines.zh: 这世界该没人，你为什么还在？
lines.en: This world should be empty; why are you here?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯一处错误。
lines.en: I stare at you like a mistake.

lines.zh: 复眼里只有一个你，很碍眼。
lines.en: In my compound eyes there is only you, and it bothers me.

lines.zh: 我的薄翅被撕开了。
lines.en: My thin wings are torn.

lines.zh: 腿部受伤了。
lines.en: Leg injured.

lines.zh: 腹部被咬了。
lines.en: Abdomen bitten.

lines.zh: 翅膀被击中。
lines.en: Wing hit.

lines.zh: 尾巴受伤了。
lines.en: Tail injured.

lines.zh: 身体被刺穿。
lines.en: Body pierced.

lines.zh: 翅膀被砍伤。
lines.en: Wing cut.

lines.zh: 腹部被撕裂。
lines.en: Abdomen torn.

lines.zh: 翅膀断了。
lines.en: Wing broken.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了，雾也补不上。
lines.en: My shell cracked; the fog cannot mend it.

lines.zh: 它朝你蠕动过来，露出尖锐的牙齿。
lines.en: It crawls towards you, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中拍打着，发出低沉的嗡嗡声。
lines.en: Its wings beat in the air, producing a low hum.

lines.zh: 靠近它会引起它的注意，小心它的攻击。
lines.en: Getting too close will draw its attention; watch out for attacks.

lines.zh: 它的触角在黑暗中显得格外显眼。
lines.en: Its antennae stand out in the dark.

lines.zh: 它用尖刺保护自己免受侵害。
lines.en: It uses its spikes to defend itself.

lines.zh: 它的触角寻找着食物的踪迹。
lines.en: Its antennae seek out food.

lines.zh: 它的外观非常诱人，让人难以抗拒。
lines.en: Its appearance is incredibly tempting.

lines.zh: 你发现它隐藏在树叶之间。
lines.en: You spot it hidden among the leaves.

lines.zh: 它的体色是深绿色，与树叶相似。
lines.en: Its body is a deep green, similar to leaves.

lines.zh: 它的叫声像是在寻找配偶。
lines.en: Its call sounds like it’s searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它的触角撞上了你的盔甲。
lines.en: Its antennae bump into your armor.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中与你的剑相撞。
lines.en: Its wings collide with your sword in the air.

lines.zh: 它试图用角撞击你。
lines.en: It tries to ram you with its horns.

lines.zh: 它的撞击力道惊人。
lines.en: Its collisions are powerful.

lines.zh: 它的触角紧紧缠绕在一起。
lines.en: Its antennae tangle together.

lines.zh: 它的身体与你的相撞，发出沉闷的声响。
lines.en: Its body collides with yours, producing a dull sound.

lines.zh: 它的触须与你的盔甲摩擦。
lines.en: Its feelers rub against your armor.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍打在你的盾牌上。
lines.en: Its wings beat against your shield.

lines.zh: 它试图用身体阻止你的前进。
lines.en: It tries to stop your advance with its body.

lines.zh: 它的攻击方式是猛烈的撞击。
lines.en: Its attack is a powerful ram.

lines.zh: 我喉里挤出求偶的声。
lines.en: A courting rasp scrapes out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我循着同类的气味找。
lines.en: I follow the scent of my own kind.

lines.zh: 它的叫声吸引着同类。
lines.en: Its call draws in同类.

lines.zh: 它试图接近潜在的伴侣。
lines.en: It tries to approach a potential mate.

lines.zh: 它用触角触碰对方。
lines.en: It touches its mate with its antennae.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中充满了爱意。
lines.en: Its call is full of love.

lines.zh: 我与同伴的颚轻轻相碰。
lines.en: My jaws tap my mate's jaws softly.

lines.zh: 它寻找着能够生育的伴侣。
lines.en: It searches for a fertile mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在夜晚回荡。
lines.en: Its call echoes through the night.

lines.zh: 它与伴侣一起飞舞。
lines.en: It dances with its mate.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，它吐出毒液！
lines.en: Sssss, it spits venom!

lines.zh: 它的触角扫过地面，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its antennae sweep the ground, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 它张开大嘴，准备吞噬一切。
lines.en: It opens its huge mouth, ready to devour all.

lines.zh: 饥饿的触须缠绕向你，致命的拥抱。
lines.en: Hungry tentacles wrap around you, a deadly embrace.

lines.zh: 它的体型巨大，行动缓慢，但致命。
lines.en: Its large, slow form, but deadly.

lines.zh: 地面震动，它正在接近。
lines.en: The ground trembles; it's approaching.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着恶意的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with malicious intent.

lines.zh: 它从阴影中探出头来，寻找猎物。
lines.en: It pokes its head out of the shadows, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 腐烂的触须散发出恶臭。
lines.en: Decaying tentacles emit a foul stench.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同死亡的低吟。
lines.en: Its voice is a low, deathly whisper.

lines.zh: 蝗虫的腿，已经弹起来了。
lines.en: The locust's legs are already loaded.

lines.zh: 你被锁定！
lines.en: You are targeted!

lines.zh: 玩家进入视野！
lines.en: Player in sight!

lines.zh: 雾里那点热，是你。
lines.en: That spot of warmth in the fog is you.

lines.zh: 我的腿一弹，你就听不见了。
lines.en: One spring of my legs and you go deaf.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在空村里很响。
lines.en: Your steps echo through the empty village.

lines.zh: 玩家成为目标！
lines.en: Player targeted!

lines.zh: 村里只有你还在走动。
lines.en: You are the only thing still moving here.

lines.zh: 蝗虫锁定了，一口就够。
lines.en: The locust has locked on, one bite is enough.

lines.zh: 它已经盯上你！
lines.en: It's got you in its sights!

lines.zh: 锁定你，世界就干净了。
lines.en: Lock on to you and the world is clean again.

lines.zh: 这雾本来只该有我的脚步声。
lines.en: This fog should hold only my footsteps.

lines.zh: 你成了我名单上唯一的名字。
lines.en: You are the only name left on my list.

lines.zh: 别找了，方圆千里没有别人。
lines.en: Stop searching; there is no one for miles.

lines.zh: 我来补上这空世界的缺口。
lines.en: I will fill the gap in this empty world.

lines.zh: 你被听见了，所以你得消失。
lines.en: You were heard, so you must vanish.

lines.zh: 它向你逼近，准备攻击。
lines.en: It advances to attack.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶作响，准备吞噬。
lines.en: It hisses, ready to devour.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它的靠近。
lines.en: You feel its approach.

lines.zh: 它将你视为猎物。
lines.en: You are its prey.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕向你。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you.

lines.zh: 你躲闪不及，被攻击了。
lines.en: You can't dodge the attack.

lines.zh: 雾里只有我，还有你。
lines.en: In the fog there is only me and you.

lines.zh: 它的触须刺向你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its tentacles pierce your skin.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，准备近战。
lines.en: It approaches to melee.

lines.zh: 它的利爪划过你的身体。
lines.en: Its claws scratch your body.

lines.zh: 我不急，雾会替我把你围住。
lines.en: No hurry; the fog will close around you.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候，我就近了一步。
lines.en: When the light dies, I take one step closer.

lines.zh: 你听到的那声怪响是我。
lines.en: That strange sound you heard was me.

lines.zh: 翅膀压低，我贴着雾滑过去。
lines.en: Wings low, I glide through the fog.

lines.zh: 你转身，我换一个方向。
lines.en: You turn; I switch directions.

lines.zh: 你听见翅膀，却看不见来源。
lines.en: You hear wings but see no source.

lines.zh: 洞穴里那件事也是我做的。
lines.en: What happened in the cave was also me.

lines.zh: 你的火把只照到十步，够我靠近。
lines.en: Your torch reaches ten steps; enough for me.

lines.zh: 我在等你怀疑自己听见了什么。
lines.en: I wait for you to doubt what you heard.

lines.zh: 这世界安静得很，除了你。
lines.en: This world is quiet, except for you.

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的翅膀，向你俯冲而来！
lines.en: It spreads its massive wings and dives at you!

lines.zh: 它的甲壳发出咔嚓声，向你冲来！
lines.en: Its exoskeleton crunches as it charges at you!

lines.zh: 它的触角在你周围挥舞，寻找破绽！
lines.en: Its antennae swing around, searching for a weakness!

lines.zh: 它突然跳跃，用大颚咬向你！
lines.en: It leaps, clamping its mandibles on you!

lines.zh: 它用大钳子夹住你的手臂，用力撕咬！
lines.en: It grabs your arm with its claws and rips at it!

lines.zh: 它快速挥动触手，向你抽打！
lines.en: Its tentacles whiplash at you!

lines.zh: 它喷出黏液，试图粘住你！
lines.en: It spits slime, trying to stick to you!

lines.zh: 它用大颚紧紧咬住你不放！
lines.en: Its mandibles clamp on you tightly!

lines.zh: 它从背上弹出毒刺，向你注射毒液！
lines.en: It launches its venomous spines at you!

lines.zh: 它用大颚发出咔嚓声，咬碎你的骨头！
lines.en: Its mandibles crunch, breaking your bones!

lines.zh: 大颚咬住你的手腕。
lines.en: My mandibles clamp your wrist.

lines.zh: 前腿的刺扎进你的脖子。
lines.en: A foreleg spine sinks into your neck.

lines.zh: 我跃起，撞在你的胸口。
lines.en: I leap and strike your chest.

lines.zh: 翅膀一扇，把你扇得踉跄。
lines.en: One wingbeat staggers you.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护甲缝隙。
lines.en: I bite into the gap of your armor.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我扑到你背上。
lines.en: A hind-leg kick and I'm on your back.

lines.zh: 触角缠住你的手指。
lines.en: My antennae coil around your fingers.

lines.zh: 我啃你的靴子，磨钝不了我的牙。
lines.en: I gnaw your boot; my teeth stay sharp.

lines.zh: 雾里我一击即退。
lines.en: In the fog I strike once and withdraw.

lines.zh: 我的口器在你耳边响。
lines.en: My mouthparts click beside your ear.

lines.zh: 夜晚降临，它从地底涌出！
lines.en: It emerges from the ground as night falls!

lines.zh: 它蜷缩在黑暗的洞穴深处！
lines.en: It curls up in the dark depths of a cave!

lines.zh: 它在沼泽中缓缓爬行！
lines.en: It crawls slowly through the marsh!

lines.zh: 它在密林的阴影中潜行！
lines.en: It slinks through the shadows of the dense forest!

lines.zh: 它在腐烂的草丛中苏醒！
lines.en: It awakens in the decaying grass!

lines.zh: 它在废弃的矿井中游荡！
lines.en: It wanders through abandoned mines!

lines.zh: 它从远处的树林中跃出！
lines.en: It leaps from the distant woods!

lines.zh: 它从黑暗的裂隙中现身！
lines.en: It appears from a dark fissure!

lines.zh: 它在腐烂的树根中出没！
lines.en: It prowls among decaying tree roots!

lines.zh: 它在夜色中静静地等待！
lines.en: It waits quietly in the night!

lines.zh: 雾起了，我在这世界里落脚。
lines.en: The fog rises and I settle into this world.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那一瞬，我到了。
lines.en: The instant the light dies, I arrive.

lines.zh: 没有别的生物，只有我。
lines.en: No other creatures; only me.

lines.zh: 我从这片寂静里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of this silence.

lines.zh: 火焰烧伤。
lines.en: Burned by fire.

lines.zh: 摔伤了。
lines.en: Fell and hurt.

lines.zh: 雾里只有我，水也淹不死我。
lines.en: Only I move in the fog, and water will not drown me.

lines.zh: 爆炸伤。
lines.en: Explosion hurt.

lines.zh: 箭矢伤。
lines.en: Arrow hit.

lines.zh: 魔法伤。
lines.en: Magic hurt.

lines.zh: 饥饿伤。
lines.en: Starvation hurt.

lines.zh: 闪电伤。
lines.en: Lightning struck.

lines.zh: 坠落虚空。
lines.en: Fall into void.
